entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: I am the one who grants the desires of[n]the masses... I give life to their voices...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If we don't do something about those[n]blood-pumping supply-line things,[n]this'll never end!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Our opponent knows that too though.[n]It'll try and stop us if we go straight[n]for them!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We'll need to send someone in to[n]cut the lines.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then while they're out, everyone else[n]will have to keep attacking to distract[n]the Holy Grail!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Guys, it's no use! We've gotta go cut[n]its supply lines first!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: The happiness of the populace rests in[n]my regulation...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Those who cannot understand must be[n]eliminated.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Those who cannot understand must be[n]eliminated.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It hasn't noticed me yet. I'll keep[n]going... Just a little more!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Looks like it don't know I'm here.[n]Imma keep goin'... Almost there!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't think it's noticed me. Things are[n]all going according to plan... Here I go!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Good, it has yet to notice me...[n]I'm moving forth!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It hasn't seen me, has it? I'll use this[n]moment to push forward!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is going well! I'll proceed![n]Please don't notice me...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: The masses that praise the Holy Grail[n]are infinite.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Their desires and power in turn[n]grant me immortality.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Their desires and power in turn[n]grant me immortality.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I'll show you the real desires of[n]the masses!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm cutting them!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Enough of your ramblin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! Time to cut 'em!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry, but that's not happening!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm going to cut them!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Don't waste your breath!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will sever them!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's time you see what the masses[n]truly desire!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll cut the lines now!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Eternal may be a bit of an exaggeration.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm going to cut them!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Fools...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It worked! How's that!?

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: You repugnant rebels...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It can't heal itself anymore! This'll be[n]a head-to-head fight from now on![n]Take it down!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Hm...? I am no longer receiving the[n]strength of the inmates!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: You truly wish to destroy me...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: How dare you plot against me...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: You repugnant rebels...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Curses! Nothing is coming from the[n]inmates...! I cannot heal myself at this[n]rate...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: You truly wish to destroy me...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Imbeciles...!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Imbeciles...!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: It seems I must punish you for your[n]transgressions!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We didn't ask for your justice!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: You shall taste my power...!
